raw.details:
What if you could redesign the digital identity of a national-level youth organization?

Welcome to the InteractUp National Hackathon, a multi-round competition where creativity meets technology and ideas transform into real digital experiences. This is your opportunity to build, experiment, innovate and showcase what you can create using technology.

The Challenge:

Explore www.interactup.in and reimagine it.

Your mission is to redesign, develop and deploy your own version of the InteractUp website, creating an exceptional UI/UX experience that is visually impressive, intuitive, interactive and genuinely useful.

Think beyond conventional websites. Experiment with immersive experiences, 3D elements, animations, interactive storytelling, creative navigation, innovative features, unique layouts or anything else your imagination can bring to life.

Your website should be designed keeping multiple audiences in mind, including:

  • Students and young professionals
  • Colleges and educational institutions
  • Companies, brands and potential partners
  • Communities, event participants and aspiring entrepreneurs

Build something that students want to explore, colleges find valuable, companies find interesting and visitors find memorable.

You are free to use any programming language, framework, development platform, technology, AI tool or workflow. Your creativity and execution are in your hands.

The existing website is your starting point, not your design limitation. You are free to introduce new sections, experiences, features, layouts and interactions that you believe would make the platform more attractive and effective.

Make sure to join the following WhatsApp group: https://chat.whatsapp.com/LVXuFXetdjK0S8jAUXOZgh

Three Rounds. Multiple Challenges. One Winning Team.

This hackathon consists of three project-based rounds. Round 1 begins with the InteractUp website innovation challenge. Participants progressing through the competition will encounter additional project challenges in subsequent rounds.

Each round is an opportunity to push your creativity further, solve new challenges and demonstrate your ability to build meaningful digital experiences.

Rewards

₹50,000 Total Cash Prize Pool

  • Top 5 Winners: ₹10,000 each
  • Internship Opportunity: Winners will also receive an internship opportunity with InteractUp.
  • Exceptional Work Bonus: If a submission demonstrates exceptional creativity, quality and real-world potential, and the website is deemed suitable for actual deployment by InteractUp, the participant may receive an additional ₹50,000 bonus. This is for a website that goes beyond the competition, has the potential to strengthen InteractUp's digital presence, attract brands and partners, and create meaningful opportunities for collaboration.

What You Must Submit:

For Round 1, participants are required to submit:

  • Live Website: Link to your deployed, functional website.
  • Source Code: Link to your GitHub repository or equivalent or put all relevant folders and files in the drive.
  • Walkthrough Video: A video demonstrating your website, its features and overall experience.
  • Project Documentation: An explanation of your concept, design decisions, features and development approach.
  • Tools & AI Disclosure: Details of the technologies, development tools and AI tools used in a word file.

All submissions must be compiled into one Word document (.docx) containing the required links and information. Participants must also provide a Google Drive folder containing their walkthrough video and supporting materials.

Refer to the Round 1 Rules & Guidelines for complete submission instructions.

Why Participate?

  • Build real projects instead of just presenting ideas.
  • Showcase your creativity, technical skills and problem-solving ability.
  • Experiment with AI, modern technologies and innovative development approaches.
  • Challenge yourself through multiple project-based rounds.
  • Gain recognition for your work and compete with talented innovators.
  • Earn a cash prize and an internship opportunity.

This is your chance to turn your ideas into something real, demonstrate what you can build and stand out through your work.

Don't just make a website. Make us rethink what InteractUp's website could be.

Reimagine. Build. Compete.

About Interactup

InteractUp is a registered national-level NGO dedicated to empowering young people through opportunities, leadership, innovation and collaboration. With a growing network of students and young professionals across India, it brings together ambitious individuals, institutions and organizations to create meaningful impact. Through national competitions, entrepreneurship initiatives, leadership programs, networking opportunities and international youth summits, InteractUp provides platforms for young people to learn, lead, innovate and grow. With its reach extending across India and engagement with international communities, InteractUp is building bridges between talent, ideas, institutions and opportunities, empowering the next generation of leaders, entrepreneurs and changemakers.
